desc:
[🖱️] Textlife – The Life Simulator

Put your decision-making skills to the test in a text-based world where one wrong click can ruin your life.

Will you study hard and become a brain surgeon, or drop out to start a life of crime? Every year brings new choices, random events, and consequences that shape who you become.

Whether you choose fame, infamy, or mediocrity, in the end, it is...
Your story, your choices, your Textlife.

Dempsey [Artist]
Bitlife [Inspiration]
